pages.title: Using the book
pages.text:
Copper, wood and cobblestone are all you need to start.
Next steps shows what to do now. Each step you finish unlocks new recipes.
Click an icon for its recipe. Hover it for stats, hold Shift for more.

pages.title: Five ages
pages.text:
Each age starts with a new material.
0 Clockwork: copper, wood
1 Wired: iron, gold, redstone
2 Servo: diamond, obsidian
3 Deep: netherite, blaze rods
4 Antigrav: ender pearls, nether star

pages.title: The parts ladder
pages.text:
Every age has its own casing, circuit and motor, made from the parts of the age before.
A Metal Press gets twice the plates out of your ingots that the Tinker's Hammer does.

pages.title: Making FE
pages.text:
Start with the Winding Crank: wind a Mainspring by hand to run your first robots.
Once you have iron, build a Combustion Generator and feed it coal or logs.
In Age 1, add Solar Panels: no fuel to keep up.
After that come the RTG, the Tesla Spire and the Core Reactor.

pages.title: Batteries
pages.text:
Right-click a robot with a cell or Mainspring to swap it in.
A cell anywhere in your inventory recharges the FE tool in your hand and your Exo suit.

pages.title: Moving FE
pages.text: Tesla Coils can link to other coils to reach further. Each hop loses 5%.

pages.title: Assembler
pages.text: It makes circuits, motors and casings for about a quarter less than crafting them. Build one early in Age 2.

pages.title: Fuel
pages.text: Keep your spent pellets: they end up as Ring Collider fuel.

pages.title: Multiblocks
pages.text: Open a controller to see what is missing. Its spyglass button outlines the wrong block in the world.

pages.title: Hollow boxes
pages.text: The Capacitor Bank and the Core Reactor are hollow boxes: casing on every edge, and casing, glass or ports in the walls. The controller goes in a side wall, facing out.

pages.title: Capacitor Bank
pages.text:
Bank Ports: FE in or out, one direction each.
Capacitors: hold the FE.
Transfer Coils: how fast FE moves in and out, shared by all ports.
Mix Capacitors and Coils inside however you like.

pages.title: Smallest bank
pages.text: Glass goes in the walls, never on an edge.

pages.title: Tesla Spire
pages.text:
A column under open sky: Spire Base, conductor blocks, Spire Crown on top.
Each metal sets power and how far fuel goes; mix them freely.
Build it high, and 64 blocks away from other spires.
Storms bring lightning: every strike fills the buffer with a burst.

pages.title: Core Reactor
pages.text:
The middle block stays empty: the core floats there.
Amplifiers in the other 26 spots raise power but burn fuel and the core faster, for fewer FE per pellet. Stabilizers do the opposite.
A core in the core slot waits until the one inside burns out.

pages.title: Ring Collider
pages.text:
A flat loop of segments with the controller in it. Any shape works.
Charge it with FE (a Capacitor Bank helps), add fuel and press Running.
Do not let the fuel run out: the beam collapses and needs a new charge.
Bigger rings make Strange Matter faster.

pages.title: Stumpy and Sprout
pages.text:
Sprout also picks berries, melons, pumpkins, sugar cane, cactus, bamboo and kelp.
Sneak-right-click a robot to see its status and work area. A robot that smokes is stuck; its status says why.

pages.title: Rancher
pages.text:
Name or leash an animal to keep it from being culled.
Its lamp is green while working, amber with no feed and red when stuck.

pages.title: Mining Drone
pages.text:
Right-click a block to deploy it, sneak-right-click to pick it up. Give it a battery and torches.
Drone key (default H): dig where you look. With sneak: call it back.

pages.title: Sentry Drone
pages.text: Repair it with iron.

pages.title: Courier and Hauler
pages.text: A Courier Drone can run up to 4 routes.

pages.title: Upgrade cards
pages.text:
Pair Speed cards with Efficiency cards: speed makes every action cost more FE.
Upgrading a placed machine to the next Mk keeps everything inside it.

pages.title: Excavator
pages.text: It skips chests and other block entities in its way.

pages.title: Survey Rig
pages.text: A Magma Core in its core slot adds ancient debris and resonite.

pages.title: Modules
pages.text:
FE gear can't be enchanted. Modules take the place of enchantments.
Higher module levels need a higher Age or Mk.

pages.title: Drills
pages.text:
Hold sneak to mine a single block.
Smithing a tool up keeps its energy, settings and modules.

pages.title: Tool modules
pages.text:
Overclock, Fortune and Silk Touch only work while the tool has FE.
Spark Lamps float and crackle. Sneak-right-click one with the Lamp Rod to remove it.

pages.title: Trees
pages.text: They replant from saplings in your inventory.

pages.title: Weapons
pages.text: Chain Lightning fits the Arc Blade, Ricochet the Rivet Gun.

pages.title: Scrap Colossus
pages.text:
The chest in a Rusted Foundry holds a Signal Flare. Later you can craft flares and your own altar.
The altar has a 5 minute cooldown. The loot is locked to the killer for 2 minutes.

pages.title: Colossus fight
pages.text:
Arms up: it slams. Jump, or get 5 blocks away.
Arm back: it throws scrap. Keep moving.
Below half health it calls drones and overheats. When its furnace opens, hit it for double damage.

pages.title: Forge Tyrant
pages.text: The chest in a Cinder Forge holds an Ignition Charge.

pages.title: Tyrant fight
pages.text:
Doors glow: flame breath. Step aside.
Crucible back: magma globs. Keep moving.
Hammer up: glowing rings on the ground. Get off them.
Doors open: it vents. Hit it for double damage.

pages.title: The suit
pages.text:
Out of FE it still works as armor, but its modules stop.
Smithing a piece up keeps its energy and modules. Mk4 pieces are fireproof.

pages.title: Core socket
pages.text:
Needs a Mk2 chestplate and all four pieces at Mk2 or higher.
Servo: Haste and Speed on the Overclock key (default O).
Magma: fireproof, burning hits.
Antigrav: no fall damage, cheaper Flight.

pages.title: Architect Table
pages.text:
It runs on a wound Mainspring from day one, or on any FE.
Plots next to each other join into one hall. Click a plot edge for a door, a seam for an inner wall. Shift-click forgets a plot.

pages.title: Styles
pages.text:
An Iron, Reinforced or Null Casing in the casing slot opens the next style.
The stonecutter turns style blocks into other shapes.

pages.title: Clear and Demolish
pages.text:
Clearing voids junk and puts the rest in a chest touching the table.
Demolish gives back 75% of the matter for its own blocks.

pages.title: Mob Replicator
pages.text:
Harvest mode gives loot and stores the mob's experience; Spawn mode makes the real mob.
Blazes, endermen and ghasts need a Magma Core in the controller, shulkers an Antigrav Core.

pages.title: Replicator layout
pages.text: Any frame block can be glass, edges and corners too.

pages.title: Warp
pages.text:
Taking damage cancels a remote teleport.
Portal Projectors work across dimensions.

pages.title: Storage Terminal
pages.text:
Search with @mod or #tag. The J button syncs the search with JEI.
Shulker boxes and bundles only go in empty.

pages.title: Item pipes
pages.text: Items go to the highest priority arm that has room. Round robin only spreads them between arms of the same priority.

pages.title: Machine sides
pages.text: Set each face in a machine's Sides tab. Auto-input pulls from Input faces, auto-eject pushes out of Output faces.
